## 🗺️ Step-by-Step Guide

<!-- Detailed walkthrough for newcomers -->

### Prerequisites

**You'll need:**
- [ ] Git installed
- [ ] GitHub account
- [ ] Text editor (VS Code, Sublime, etc.)
- [ ] Web browser
- [ ] Other: _______

**Helpful to know (but not required):**
- Basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript
- Git basics (commit, push, pull)
- How to open browser DevTools

### Step 1: Set Up Your Environment

```bash
# Fork the repository on GitHub, then:
git clone https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/infin-love.git
cd infin-love
git checkout -b fix/issue-NUMBER-description
```

**Need help with Git?** See [ONBOARDING.md](../../ONBOARDING.md#your-first-contribution-step-by-step)

### Step 2: Locate the File(s)

**Files you'll need to edit:**
- `path/to/file.ext` - What it does

**How to find them:**
1. Open the project folder in your text editor
2. Navigate to the file listed above
3. Find the section around line XX (approximate)

### Step 3: Make the Changes

**What to change:**

<!-- Provide specific code snippets or clear instructions -->

**Before:**
```html
<!-- Current code -->
```

**After:**
```html
<!-- Expected code -->
```

**Or, in plain language:**
1. Find the section that does X
2. Change Y to Z
3. Add a comment explaining why

### Step 4: Test Your Changes

**How to test:**
1. Open `index.html` in your web browser
2. Check that [specific thing] works correctly
3. Test on mobile view (DevTools → Device mode)
4. Verify no console errors (F12 → Console tab)

**Expected result:**


### Step 5: Commit and Push

```bash
# Stage your changes
git add path/to/file.ext

# Commit with clear message
git commit -m "fix: brief description of fix

- More detailed point 1
- More detailed point 2

Fixes #ISSUE-NUMBER"

# Push to your fork
git push origin fix/issue-NUMBER-description
```

### Step 6: Open a Pull Request

1. Go to your fork on GitHub
2. Click "Compare & pull request"
3. Fill in the PR template
4. Link this issue (mention #ISSUE-NUMBER)
5. Submit and wait for review!

## ❓ Questions? Need Help?

**Don't hesitate to ask!** Some ways to get help:

1. **Comment on this issue** - Ask anything, we'll respond
2. **GitHub Discussions** - [Start a discussion](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/infin-love/discussions)
3. **Read the docs** - [SUPPORT.md](../../SUPPORT.md) has more help options

**Common questions:**

<details>
<summary>How do I fork the repository?</summary>

1. Click the "Fork" button at the top right of this repository
2. This creates a copy under your GitHub account
3. Clone YOUR fork (not the original)

See: [GitHub's Forking Guide](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/quickstart/fork-a-repo)
</details>

<details>
<summary>What if I make a mistake?</summary>

That's totally okay! Mistakes are part of learning:
- We'll help you fix it
- You can update your PR with new commits
- No one will judge you
- We're all learning together
</details>

<details>
<summary>How long will my PR take to review?</summary>

- **First response**: Usually within 3 days
- **Full review**: Within 1 week
- We're volunteers, so please be patient
- We appreciate you! 💜
</details>

## 🎁 Taking This Issue

**Want to work on this?** Great!

1. **Comment below** to let us know you're interested
2. We'll assign it to you
3. **Ask questions** if anything is unclear
4. **Take your time** - no rush, no pressure
5. **Have fun!** This should be a positive experience

**Can't finish?** No problem—just let us know and we'll unassign you. No hard feelings!
